title: 第1703章 轩灵阁第1702章 另一处天地
lines: 是夜，轩辕山上灵光通明，尤其某处楼宇群中，更是频频有着乐声响起。
正是轩辕家为款待诸多势力，举办的盛宴，待盛宴过后，便是交换会了。
萧家一众修士均是前往，而王扶则拒绝了邀请，在一处幽静的阁楼中静静等候。
约莫半个时辰后，他吩咐金月漓守好陆商，便悄然离开了阁楼，往一众楼宇深处而去。
尽管身在轩辕山中，但王扶却并不担心有人会谋算陆商身上的玄兽令，毕竟这里可是轩辕圣皇之地。
当然，即便有人当真铤而走险，或者说轩辕家有所谋划，他也自有后手，倒是不必担心什么。
很快，轩灵阁到了。
这是一处可俯瞰众多亭台楼宇的阁楼，当王扶飘然而落时，分明瞧见一道人影在阁楼大门旁静静立着，似乎刻意在此等候。
但当王扶瞧见那身影真容时，目光却微微闪烁。
无他，此人竟是那位轩辕家的家主，轩辕宁汐。
“见过王前辈。”
此女瞧见突然现身面前的王扶，也不免娇躯轻颤，但紧接着便又恭敬非常地欠身施礼，并继续笑吟吟的开口：
“崔前辈已在阁楼中恭候多时了。”
“没想到竟是轩辕家主在此，倒是让王某受宠若惊啊，不过如此看来，崔道友应还邀请了轩辕家的道友吧。不知是你轩辕家哪位长老？”王扶看着此女，若有所思的问了一句。
“这个……晚辈无法相告，前辈入阁之后便知。”轩辕宁汐讪讪一笑。
“也好，那便带路吧。”王扶微微颔首，也不再为难此女。
“前辈请。”轩辕宁汐心中松了口气，随后便伸手示意，并在前面带路。
很快，王扶跟着此女进去了轩灵阁中，并在其领路之下，踏上楼梯，登上了阁楼顶层。
此处分明有极强的禁制波动，阻隔一切神念探察，纵使合体大圆满的神念，也不可能短时间突破。
且一触之下，必然被禁制中的人察觉。
如此阵仗，倒是让王扶神色一凝，但一想到崔冥所说之话，便又释然了。
毕竟，此事可是涉及大乘之境，至于飞升渡劫，王扶还是有些不信的。
轩辕宁汐止步禁制之前，随后手指捏诀，一点灵光点出，面前禁制立马如帷幕一般朝着两旁分开。
“前辈请。”此女欠身示意。
王扶微微颔首，随后迈步踏入其中，禁制一开，他便已经瞧见了其中的两道身影，正于厅中相对而坐，品茶交谈。
而当王扶迈步而入时，两人不约而同地扭头望来。
王扶略微一打量，顿时一惊。
实在是其中一人，让他半点也未曾想到。
崔冥老鬼自不必说，此刻正坐于厅中右侧，而其对面那人，一袭道袍，竟是轩辕圣皇。
王扶还以为是那轩辕洪，不曾想还是远远低估了。
而这位轩辕圣皇似对王扶的惊讶很是受用，望来时不觉抚须而笑。
“嘿嘿，没想到竟是王道友先一步到了，看来道友对老夫所说之事，很是上心啊。”崔冥瞧见王扶到来，则是一脸笑意，甚至起身拱手相迎，将王扶迎至他身旁的座位。
“崔道友客气了，道友所说之事，王某很难不上心。”王扶一笑，随后安然坐下。
他听得出，还有人未至。
content_en:
It was night, and the auras on Xuanyuan Mountain were brightly lit. Especially in a group of buildings, there was frequent music.
It was a feast held by the Xuanyuan family to entertain many forces. After the feast, there was an exchange meeting.
All the monks from the Xiao family went there, but Wang Fu declined the invitation and waited quietly in a quiet attic.
About half an hour later, he told Jin Yueli to guard Lu Shang, then quietly left the attic and went deep into the buildings.
Although he was in Xuanyuan Mountain, Wang Fu was not worried that someone would plot against Lu Shang's Mysterious Beast Order. After all, this was the land of Xuanyuan Holy Emperor.
Of course, even if someone really takes risks, or the Xuanyuan family has a plan, he has his own backup plan, so there is nothing to worry about.
Soon, Xuanling Pavilion arrived.
This is an attic overlooking many pavilions and buildings. When Wang Fu floated down, he clearly saw a figure standing quietly by the attic door, as if he was waiting here deliberately.
But when Wang Fu saw the true appearance of the figure, his eyes flickered slightly.
Without him, this person turned out to be the head of the Xuanyuan family, Xuanyuan Ningxi.
"I've met Senior Wang."
When the woman saw Wang Fu who suddenly appeared in front of her, her body trembled slightly, but then she bowed respectfully and saluted, and continued to speak with a smile:
"Senior Cui has been waiting in the attic for a long time."
"I didn't expect that the head of the Xuanyuan family was here, so Wang was flattered. But it seems that Fellow Taoist Cui must have invited fellow Taoists from the Xuanyuan family. I wonder which elder of the Xuanyuan family is this?" Wang Fu looked at the woman and asked thoughtfully.
"This... junior can't tell me, senior will know after he joins the cabinet." Xuanyuan Ningxi smiled sarcastically.
"Okay, then just lead the way." Wang Fu nodded slightly and stopped embarrassing the woman.
"Senior, please." Xuanyuan Ningxi breathed a sigh of relief, then extended her hand to signal and led the way.
Soon, Wang Fu followed the woman into Xuanling Pavilion, and led the way up the stairs to the top of the attic.
There are clearly extremely strong forbidden fluctuations here, blocking all spiritual exploration. Even if the divine thoughts of the Great Perfection are combined, it is impossible to break through in a short time.
And if you touch it, it will definitely be noticed by the person in the restraint.
Such a battle made Wang Fu look tense, but when he thought of what Cui Ming said, he felt relieved again.
After all, this matter involves the realm of Mahayana. As for ascending to transcend tribulations, Wang Fu still doesn't believe it.
Xuanyuan Ningxi stopped before restraining, then squeezed the formula with her fingers, and a little light came out, and the restraint in front of her immediately opened to both sides like a curtain.
"Senior, please." The woman bowed and signaled.
Wang Fu nodded slightly, and then stepped into it. As soon as the restriction was opened, he saw two figures sitting opposite each other in the hall, drinking tea and talking.
When Wang Fu stepped in, the two of them turned to look at each other.
Wang Fu looked at it for a moment and was suddenly surprised.
In fact, it was one of them that he never expected at all.
Needless to say, the old ghost Cui Ming is sitting on the right side of the hall at the moment, and the person opposite him, dressed in Taoist robes, is actually the Holy Emperor Xuanyuan.
Wang Fu thought it was Xuanyuan Hong, but he had underestimated it.
The Holy Emperor Xuanyuan seemed to take advantage of Wang Fu's surprise, and he smiled while stroking his beard.
"Hey, I didn't expect that Fellow Daoist Wang arrived first. It seems that Fellow Daoist is very concerned about what I said." Cui Ming saw Wang Fu arriving, with a smile on his face, and even stood up to greet Wang Fu, and welcomed Wang Fu to the seat next to him.
"You're welcome, Fellow Taoist Cui. It's hard for Wang not to be concerned about what Fellow Taoist said." Wang Fu smiled and then sat down peacefully.
He could tell that there were still people who hadn't arrived yet.
